simple.meaning: מָרָא (mârâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to rebel ; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip , i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Job, Zephaniah, beginning at Job 39:18. Its contexts include city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָרָא (H4754).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to rebel ; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip , i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running)
definitions.full: H4754. mara I.
